_readme: Vale of Banners wave 1 music, one cue per slot. Instrumental only.

title.prompt: Medieval pastoral instrumental game music, lute, recorder and frame drum, warm and light, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Title theme: a gentle dawn melody on recorder over soft lute arpeggios, 80 BPM, hopeful and welcoming, 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar.

main.prompt: Medieval pastoral instrumental game music, lute, recorder and frame drum, warm and light, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Main play loop: a relaxed walking lute groove with light frame drum, a playful recorder tune, 96 BPM, calm and thinking-friendly, 32-bar loop that ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly.

finale.prompt: Medieval pastoral instrumental game music, lute, recorder and frame drum, warm and light, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Finale loop for the last season: the same tune family, fuller with layered lutes, hand drums and a rising recorder line, 108 BPM, tense but cheerful, 16-bar loop ending on a whole bar.

victory.prompt: Medieval pastoral instrumental game music, lute, recorder and frame drum, warm and light, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Short victory sting: a bright lute flourish and recorder fanfare with a festive drum roll, 100 BPM, 4 bars, ends on a clear major chord.

defeat.prompt: Medieval pastoral instrumental game music, lute, recorder and frame drum, warm and light, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Short defeat sting: a slow wistful recorder phrase over a soft low lute, 70 BPM, 4 bars, gentle, ends on an unresolved minor chord.
